create_referrential_grounding_evaluator: create a ReferrentialGroundingEvaluator instance to evaluate 3D referential grounding on a dataset with given thresholds and top-k values
run_process_single: run process_single to evaluate predicted 3D instance masks and bounding boxes against ground truth for a single scene
run_process_single_gt: run process_single_gt to evaluate 3D referential grounding using ground truth masks instead of predicted masks
run_evaluate: run evaluate to aggregate detection and mask results across all processed samples and print a summary table
visualize_pc_masks_and_bbox: visualize 3D point clouds with ground truth and predicted masks, bounding boxes, and anchor objects using pyviz3d
